recognize_zh: 視野內幾乎都是中型芽細胞，核圓或有切跡、染色質細緻、細胞質少量淡藍且無顆粒，偶見較小而染色質較深的細胞，右下有一顆含空泡的巨噬細胞；這種單一族群且無顆粒的芽細胞提示淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Predominant intermediate-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round, oval or notched nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli small or inconspicuous
Admixed smaller cells with more condensed chromatin
No Auer rods or granules in the blast population
Occasional vacuolated macrophage (lower right) and smeared cell strands in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is largely replaced by intermediate-sized blasts with high N:C ratios, round to notched nuclei, fine chromatin and scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm. Nucleoli are small or inconspicuous and no Auer rods are seen. Scattered smaller cells with condensed chromatin and an occasional vacuolated macrophage are present. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia, pending immunophenotypic confirmation of B lineage.

ddx.vs: Cannot be separated morphologically; cytoplasmic CD3 expression by flow cytometry defines T lineage.

ddx.dx: AML with minimal differentiation or without maturation
ddx.vs: Blasts may have more cytoplasm and occasional Auer rods, and show MPO positivity or myeloid antigen expression rather than CD19/CD10/CD79a.
TdT-negative with surface light chain restriction, CD5 and cyclin D1 positivity.
Hematogones are a minor population with homogeneous condensed chromatin and a normal maturational antigen continuum by flow.
